vars.name: TARGET_URL
vars.description: Beads-viewer base URL to audit. In-pod this is the port-forward tunnel http://localhost:8095 (see gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md for why the public ingress is unreachable from agent pods). The harness hits {{TARGET_URL}}/formulas, {{TARGET_URL}}/{formula} and {{TARGET_URL}}/{molecule}.

vars.name: FORMULA_ID
vars.description: The type=formula bead whose structure-DAG page is audited. If empty/placeholder, step-1 picks the busiest recipe (most steps, ideally with depends_on edges AND live molecules) and passes it forward via a comment. Captured by the Playwright harness as page 'formula-dag'.

vars.name: MOLECULE_ID
vars.description: The type=molecule bead whose execution view is audited. If empty/placeholder, step-1 picks a live in-flight molecule (open, mixed step statuses so the frontier is non-trivial) poured from {{FORMULA_ID}} if one exists, else the busiest open molecule. Captured as page 'molecule-exec'.

vars.name: ITERATION
vars.description: Iteration tag (fire-time ISO or date stamp) used as the output directory name under docs/formula-ux/<ITERATION>/. Keeps multiple pours from colliding. On the scheduled gardener this is wired to {{fire_time_iso}}.

vars.name: PARENT_EPIC
vars.description: Tracking epic for this work (the formula-legibility plan ka-0000007376). All bug beads filed by the file-issues step are parented here so the operator can browse one tree per dimension.

steps.title: Formula UX ({{ITERATION}}): warm up {{TARGET_URL}} and pick/verify the audit formula + molecule
steps.description:
## Step 1: Boot + Warmup + Pick Audit Targets

Confirm the three Formula surfaces are reachable AND deployed before we burn
cycles. The surfaces are the **catalog** (`GET /formulas`, handler
`handleFormulas`), the **structure DAG** (the formula's own bead page
`GET /{formula-id}`, partial `type_formula.html` + `formula_dag_svg.html`),
and the **molecule execution view** (the molecule's bead page
`GET /{molecule-id}`, partial `type_molecule.html`). All reads behind ambient
auth. Rubric: `gardenio/docs/formula-ux-rubric.md`.

### Prereq: open a local tunnel + mint a bearer

Follow `gardenio/docs/info-density-audit-harness.md` verbatim. `{{TARGET_URL}}`
is expected to be `http://localhost:8095`. Agent pods have no public route to
the viewer; port-forward to `svc/gardenio-beads-viewer:8095` and authenticate
with a Keycloak `client_credentials` bearer (advice `ka-0000006483`, helper
`gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh`).

```bash
export POD_NAMESPACE=${POD_NAMESPACE:-$(cat /var/run/secrets/kubernetes.io/serviceaccount/namespace 2>/dev/null || echo gardenio-system)}
export KC_RELEASE_NAME=${KC_RELEASE_NAME:-$POD_NAMESPACE}
# shellcheck disable=SC1091
source gardenio/tests/e2e/scripts/lib-keycloak-client-creds.sh
VIEWER_BEARER=$(mint_client_credentials_token) || { echo 'BLOCKED: bearer mint failed'; exit 1; }
kubectl -n "$POD_NAMESPACE" port-forward svc/gardenio-beads-viewer 8095:8095 > /tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log 2>&1 &
PF_PID=$!
trap 'kill $PF_PID 2>/dev/null || true' EXIT
for i in $(seq 1 30); do curl -fsS -o /dev/null -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "http://localhost:8095/health" && break; sleep 1; done
```

Without `VIEWER_BEARER`, every request returns 401 (oidcauth middleware).

### Pick the audit targets (if {{FORMULA_ID}} / {{MOLECULE_ID}} are empty/placeholder)

The DAG audit is only meaningful for a recipe with real structure; the
execution audit needs a live run with a non-trivial frontier.

```bash
# Busiest recipes: most steps, prefer ones with live molecules
kd list --type=formula --status=open --json | jq -r '.[] | .id + "\t" + .title' | head -30
kd list --type=molecule --status=open --json | jq -r '.[] | .id + "\t" + (.fields.formula_id // "-") + "\t" + .title' | head -30
```

Pick **FORMULA_ID** = a recipe with >= 4 steps and depends_on edges (open its
page and confirm `.fdag-node`s render); prefer one with open molecules so the
catalog pip strip is exercised. Pick **MOLECULE_ID** = an OPEN molecule poured
from that recipe if one exists, else the open molecule with the most child
step beads in mixed states (some done, some not — a non-trivial 'you are
here'). Record both IDs + why in a comment; downstream steps read them from
this step's comment.

### Verify the surfaces (reachable AND deployed)

With `VIEWER_BEARER` set, all of these must be < 400:

```bash
for path in "/formulas" "/{{FORMULA_ID}}" "/{{MOLECULE_ID}}" "/molecule/{{MOLECULE_ID}}/cost"; do
  code=$(curl -s -o /dev/null -w '%{http_code}' -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}")
  printf '%-40s -> %s\n' "$path" "$code"
done
```

Then the DEPLOYED check — the running build must actually contain the three
surfaces (they merged on different dates; a stale deploy silently falls back
to generic pages):

```bash
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}/formulas"        | grep -c 'formula-row'      # >= 1
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}/{{FORMULA_ID}}"  | grep -c 'formula-structure' # >= 1 (fdag-node if DAG drawable)
curl -fsS -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}/{{MOLECULE_ID}}" | grep -c 'molecule-exec'    # >= 1
```

If a surface is reachable but the marker class is absent, the deployed build
predates that surface's merge. That is **BLOCKED-pending-release, not a bug**:
comment 'BLOCKED: <surface> not in deployed build (check latest release tag vs
merge SHA)' and stop — do NOT file dimension bugs against an undeployed
surface.

### Deliverables (post as comments, then close)
- Comment: chosen FORMULA_ID + MOLECULE_ID + how they were selected.
- Comment: per-path HTTP status table + the three deployed-marker counts.
- Comment: 'PASS' or per-path failure detail.

If `/formulas` or either bead page returns >= 400 on a DEPLOYED build, do NOT
close — file a bug parented to {{PARENT_EPIC}} and BLOCK (comment 'BLOCKED'
and stop). A broken Formula surface is itself the highest-severity finding.

steps.title: Formula UX ({{ITERATION}}): capture screenshots + DOM for /formulas, {{FORMULA_ID}}, {{MOLECULE_ID}}
steps.description:
## Step 2: Capture

Run the Playwright harness against `{{TARGET_URL}}` for all THREE pages at
BOTH desktop (1280x900) and narrow (375x667) viewports and store output under
`docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/`. The Skin dimension lives in the
narrow captures, so both viewports are mandatory, not optional.

### Prereq: re-establish the tunnel + bearer (Step-1 prereq block). Read
FORMULA_ID / MOLECULE_ID from step-1's comments if the vars are placeholders.

### Steps
1. Branch off fresh main:
   ```bash
   git fetch origin && git checkout main && git pull --ff-only
   git checkout -b chore/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}
   ```
2. Capture DOM + PNGs for the three pages. Page slugs are fixed — downstream
   tooling keys on them:
   ```bash
   mkdir -p docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/{screenshots/{desktop,narrow},html}
   for spec in "formulas-catalog:/formulas" "formula-dag:/{{FORMULA_ID}}" "molecule-exec:/{{MOLECULE_ID}}"; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     curl -fsSL -H "Authorization: Bearer $VIEWER_BEARER" "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}" \
       -o "docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/html/${slug}.html"
   done
   ```
   For the PNGs reuse `gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/capture-page.mjs`
   (it already takes a bearer via BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER and viewport via
   BEADS_VIEWER_SHOT_WIDTH/HEIGHT), e.g.:
   ```bash
   cd gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots && npm ci --no-audit --no-fund 2>/dev/null || npm install
   export BEADS_VIEWER_BEARER="$VIEWER_BEARER" BEADS_VIEWER_SHOT_FULLPAGE=1
   for spec in "formulas-catalog:/formulas" "formula-dag:/{{FORMULA_ID}}" "molecule-exec:/{{MOLECULE_ID}}"; do
     slug=${spec%%:*}; path=${spec#*:}
     BEADS_VIEWER_SHOT_WIDTH=1280 BEADS_VIEWER_SHOT_HEIGHT=900 node tools/capture-page.mjs \
       "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}" "../../../docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/${slug}.png"
     BEADS_VIEWER_SHOT_WIDTH=375 BEADS_VIEWER_SHOT_HEIGHT=667 node tools/capture-page.mjs \
       "{{TARGET_URL}}${path}" "../../../docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/narrow/${slug}.png"
   done
   ```
   Also record narrow-viewport overflow while the page is up (a tiny
   Playwright eval writing `overflow.json`: per page,
   `document.documentElement.scrollWidth - window.innerWidth` at 375px).
3. Commit:
   ```bash
   git add docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/
   git commit -m "chore(formula-ux): capture {{ITERATION}} for /formulas + {{FORMULA_ID}} + {{MOLECULE_ID}}"
   ```

### Deliverables
- Branch `chore/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}` with `captures/{html,screenshots}/` populated.
- Comment: `du -sh` of captures + commit SHA + confirmation all SIX PNGs exist
  (3 pages x 2 viewports).

If the harness fails, root-cause it (dead port-forward in
`/tmp/beads-viewer-pf.log`; re-mint the bearer if expired) and BLOCK.

steps.title: Formula UX ({{ITERATION}}): compute objective CREWS metrics
steps.description:
## Step 3: Measure (objective; no judgement)

Compute the objective signals for each CREWS dimension from the captured HTML
+ a ground-truth `kd` walk. Write a small helper under
`gardenio/tests/beads-viewer-screenshots/tools/measure-formula-ux.py` (mirror
`measure-plans.py` / `measure-maps.py`) that ingests the captures dir and
emits `docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json`.

Rubric: `gardenio/docs/formula-ux-rubric.md` §2.

### C — Catalog clarity (from formulas-catalog.html)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `formula_row_count` | count of `.formula-row` |
| `kd_formula_count` | ground truth: `kd list --type=formula --status=open --json \| jq length` |
| `row_vs_truth_delta` | `kd_formula_count - formula_row_count` (0 => every recipe drawn; account for any project filter in the URL) |
| `live_count_sum` | sum of `.formula-live-count` numbers |
| `kd_open_molecule_count` | ground truth: open type=molecule beads with a formula_id that resolves to a cataloged recipe |
| `live_vs_truth_delta` | difference of the two above |
| `pip_overflow_honest` | for each row: pips shown + '+N' overflow == that recipe's live count |

### R — Recipe legibility (from formula-dag.html + the recipe JSON)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `fdag_node_count` | count of `.fdag-node` (excluding `.fdag-external`) |
| `recipe_step_count` | ground truth: `kd formula show {{FORMULA_ID}} --json` step count (post-resolve) |
| `node_vs_truth_delta` | difference (0 => every step drawn) |
| `fdag_edge_count` | count of `.fdag-edge` |
| `recipe_edge_count` | ground truth: total depends_on pairs in the recipe |
| `glyph_mismatches` | steps whose glyph class contradicts their shape (gate/branch/loop/children/task) |
| `external_count` | count of `.fdag-external` phantom nodes |
| `fallback_shown` | 1 if the flat `.formula-step-list` fallback note rendered INSTEAD of a DAG |
| `var_rail_count` | vars listed in `.formula-side-rail` vs recipe `vars` length |
| `pour_cmd_valid` | 1 if the `data-copy="pour"` value starts with `kd formula pour {{FORMULA_ID}}` |

### E — Execution honesty (from molecule-exec.html + kd walk)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `progress_done` / `progress_total` | parsed from `.molecule-progress-label` ('D/T done') |
| `kd_step_done` / `kd_step_total` | ground truth: child beads of {{MOLECULE_ID}} carrying source_step_id — closed vs all |
| `progress_vs_truth_delta` | pairwise difference (0/0 => honest) |
| `status_chip_mismatches` | per step row: `.molecule-step-status` class vs the underlying bead's real status |
| `frontier_rows` | count of `.molecule-row-frontier` |
| `frontier_truth` | ground truth: steps whose beads are ready-or-in_progress |
| `frontier_delta` | difference (0 => 'you are here' is honest) |
| `not_poured_rows` | count of `.molecule-not-poured` |
| `sse_anchor_present` | 1 if `[data-molecule-events]` present with a `/molecule/{id}/events` href |
| `sse_endpoint_ok` | 1 if `curl -m 3` on that href returns 200 and `text/event-stream` |
| `cost_link_ok` | 1 if the cost link resolves < 400 |

### W — Workbench ergonomics (all three pages)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `dead_links` | every href in the three captured pages HEAD-checked against {{TARGET_URL}} with the bearer; count >= 400 (cap the sweep at 200 distinct in-viewer hrefs) |
| `copy_btn_count` | count of `.copy-btn` with non-empty data-value on formula-dag |
| `filter_roundtrip` | fetch `/formulas?formula_type=workflow` — rows shown all carry the workflow badge |
| `raw_json_valid` | the `.formula-raw-json` pre body parses as JSON |

### S — Skin / responsive (from screenshots + overflow.json)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `overflow_catalog_narrow` | `scrollWidth - innerWidth` at 375px for /formulas (>1 => FAIL) |
| `overflow_dag_narrow` | same for the formula page |
| `overflow_molecule_narrow` | same for the molecule page |
| `near_white_ratio` | desktop pixel-density of all three pages (reuse measure-density.py) |

### Correctness (all three pages)
| Signal | How |
| --- | --- |
| `template_leaks` | count of literal `<no value>` or unrendered double-brace placeholders outside code/pre blocks (the formula pages legitimately display recipe JSON containing braces — only count leaks in page chrome, not in recipe payloads) |
| `error_markers` | count of `failed to`, `panic`, `Execution data unavailable` (case-insensitive) outside code/pre blocks |

Any `template_leaks > 0`, `error_markers > 0`, nonzero `*_vs_truth_delta`, or
`overflow_* > 1` is an automatic fail flag for its dimension.

### Deliverables
- `measure-formula-ux.py` + `metrics.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment: compact table of headline numbers per dimension.
- If a screenshot is unreadable, mark its block `null` and warn — do not BLOCK.

steps.title: Formula UX ({{ITERATION}}): score Catalog / Recipe / Execution / Workbench / Skin (CREWS)
steps.description:
## Step 4: Judge — the CREWS rubric

Produce a 0-10 score + verdict for each of the five dimensions, combining the
objective metrics (step 3) with a visual review of the screenshots. **You MUST
visually inspect** the desktop AND narrow PNGs for all three pages with the
Read tool — the screenshot is the source of truth; metrics only triage.

Rubric definitions, auto-caps, and score bands:
`gardenio/docs/formula-ux-rubric.md` §2–§3. Summary of the five dimensions:

- **C — Catalog clarity**: does /formulas answer 'what recipes do we have',
  truthfully, at a glance?
- **R — Recipe legibility**: is the structure DAG a readable, faithful drawing
  of the recipe (glyphs, edges, layers, fallback)?
- **E — Execution honesty**: THE headline dimension — does 'you are here'
  match ground truth? Progress, statuses, frontier, SSE, cost.
- **W — Workbench ergonomics**: cross-links resolve, copy commands paste
  clean, filters round-trip, the drill-path is discoverable.
- **S — Skin / responsive**: no page overflow at 375px on any of the three
  pages; looks designed at both viewports.

Weight the roll-up toward E — the plan's headline ask ('view where in its
execution a given molecule is'). Never let an E regression hide behind a high
mean.

### Output
`docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/verdicts.json`:
```json
{
  "iteration": "{{ITERATION}}", "formula_id": "{{FORMULA_ID}}", "molecule_id": "{{MOLECULE_ID}}", "target_url": "{{TARGET_URL}}",
  "scores": {
    "catalog":   {"score": 0, "verdict": "broken|weak|ok|good|excellent", "observations": "...", "issues": ["..."], "recommendations": ["..."]},
    "recipe":    {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "execution": {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "workbench": {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []},
    "skin":      {"score": 0, "verdict": "...", "observations": "...", "issues": [], "recommendations": []}
  },
  "overall": {"score": 0.0, "headline": "one-line state-of-the-formula-UX"}
}
```
Score bands: 0-3 broken, 4-5 weak, 6-7 ok, 8-9 good, 10 excellent.
`overall.score` = mean of the five.

### Deliverables
- `verdicts.json` committed on the branch.
- Comment: a 5-row CREWS scorecard (dimension | score | verdict | top recommendation) + the headline.
- Full `verdicts.json` pasted into a comment for the file-issues step.

steps.title: Formula UX ({{ITERATION}}): file bug beads per low-scoring dimension
steps.description:
## Step 5: File Issues

For every dimension in `verdicts.json` scoring **<= 6** file ONE bug bead with
that dimension's concrete recommendations. (The formula surfaces are new; the
bar tightens to <= 7 once every dimension has held >= 7 across two consecutive
iterations — note it in the report when that flips.)

### Per-dimension bug bead
```bash
kd create "Formula UX: <Dimension> scored <N>/10 — <one-line>" \
  --type=bug -p 2 \
  -l project:gardenio -l area:beads-viewer -l kind:formula-ux -l "crews:<dimension>" \
  -d "## Formula UX audit context

Iteration: {{ITERATION}}
Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/formulas (+ /{{FORMULA_ID}}, /{{MOLECULE_ID}})
Dimension: <Catalog|Recipe|Execution|Workbench|Skin>
Score: <N>/10  (verdict: <verdict>)

## Observations
<verbatim from verdicts.json>

## Issues
- <bullet>

## Recommended fixes
- <bullet>

## Evidence
- Catalog desktop:  docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/formulas-catalog.png
- DAG desktop:      docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/formula-dag.png
- Molecule desktop: docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/desktop/molecule-exec.png
- Narrow:           docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/captures/screenshots/narrow/
- Metrics:          docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/metrics.json

parent({{PARENT_EPIC}})"
```

### Deduplication (per dimension)
Before filing, search for an open bead with the same dimension scope:
```bash
kd list --status=open -l kind:formula-ux -l "crews:<dimension>" 2>&1
```
If one exists, comment the new iteration's score + evidence on it (reference
both iterations) instead of filing a duplicate. If the dimension has recovered
to 7+ this iteration, comment that on the open bead and propose closing it.

### Deliverables
- Comment listing each filed-or-updated bug bead ID + its dimension + score.
- If all five dimensions score 7+, comment 'All five CREWS dimensions >= 7
  this iteration — the formula surfaces are pulling their weight 🎉' and close
  the step.
- Do NOT close {{PARENT_EPIC}} — the report step rolls up first.

steps.title: Formula UX ({{ITERATION}}): publish roll-up report and land the MR
steps.description:
## Step 6: Report + Land MR

Produce a single rolled-up report on the parent epic and land the
captures+metrics+verdicts on main via an MR (so future iterations diff).

### Steps
1. Build `docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md`:
   - Header: iteration, target URL, audited formula + molecule, date.
   - CREWS scorecard: 5-row table — dimension | score | verdict | filed bug bead.
   - Headline (one-line state of the Formula UX) + overall mean.
   - Inline embed: desktop screenshots of all three pages.
   - Trends: if a previous iteration exists at `docs/formula-ux/<previous>/`,
     diff each dimension's score + the truth-deltas + overflow numbers; flag
     regressions. Call out E (Execution honesty) trends explicitly — the
     plan's headline ask.
   - Index of bug beads filed/updated.

2. Commit + push + open MR:
   ```bash
   git add docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md
   git commit -m "chore(formula-ux): {{ITERATION}} roll-up report"
   git push -u origin chore/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}
   glab mr create \
     --title "chore(formula-ux): {{ITERATION}} audit" \
     --description "Automated Formula UX (CREWS) audit for {{TARGET_URL}}/formulas + {{FORMULA_ID}} + {{MOLECULE_ID}}.\n\nReport: docs/formula-ux/{{ITERATION}}/REPORT.md\nParent: {{PARENT_EPIC}}\nOperator: Matt Baker" \
     --remove-source-branch --squash-before-merge
   ```

3. Wait for CI green; on a transient flake, retrigger the pipeline (NEVER
   close/reopen — global advice on pipeline retriggers).

4. Self-merge once green (operator pre-authorized via global advice
   ka-0000002230 for gardenio repos). Link the MR: `gb mr link <this-step-bead> <mr-url>`.

5. Comment on parent epic {{PARENT_EPIC}}:
   ```
   Formula-UX iteration {{ITERATION}} complete.
   Target: {{TARGET_URL}}/formulas  (recipe {{FORMULA_ID}}, molecule {{MOLECULE_ID}})
   CREWS: Catalog <c>/10 · Recipe <r>/10 · Execution <e>/10 · Workbench <w>/10 · Skin <s>/10 (overall <mean>)
   Bug beads: <list of IDs>
   Report: <permalink to REPORT.md at merge SHA>
   ```

### Deliverables
- MR URL posted as comment on this step bead + linked via `gb mr link`.
- MR merged on main.
- Comment on {{PARENT_EPIC}} with the rolled-up CREWS summary.
- Close this step bead.

This closes the molecule. The gardener trigger fires the next iteration on its
cadence — incremental, continual progress toward formula surfaces an operator
can trust at a glance.
